title: A price list in many languages
description:
Format the same data for different countries with `Intl`.

```
en-GB: Coffee £3.50, 20 Nov 2026, 1,250 sold
de-DE: Coffee 3,50 €, 20.11.2026, 1.250 sold
ja-JP: Coffee ￥350, 2026/11/20, 1,250 sold
```
hints: `new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency }).format(amount)` picks the symbol and the decimals for you (lesson 7.04).
`names.sort(new Intl.Collator(locale).compare)` sorts `Émile` next to `Emma` instead of after `Zoe`.
requirements: `formatLine(item, locale, currency)` uses `Intl.NumberFormat` for money and counts and `Intl.DateTimeFormat` for the date.
Convert prices with a rate table (prices are stored in GBP); yen has no decimals.
`sortNames(names, locale)` sorts with `Intl.Collator` so accented names sort correctly.
Exact output can differ a little between systems (spaces and symbols); that is fine.
stretch: Add relative dates with `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` ("in 3 days", "vor 2 Tagen").
